neighbours.label: the token right after a statistic describing a change over time (rose to 66 percent in 2010, has tripled in number, declining to its smallest share)
fire: The share of adults who rent their homes rose to 37 percent in 2019, according to census figures.
Online sales have doubled in the past five years, a sharp change from the decade before.
The number of bike commuters has climbed to nearly 9 percent, a record for the city.
Household savings fell to their lowest level in a generation, the report found.
Enrollment in language courses has dropped by a third since 2012, the survey shows.
The proportion of women in parliament grew to 42 percent in 2021, up from 30.
Smoking rates among teenagers have declined to their smallest share on record.
Applications to the program have tripled in number over the past three years.
quiet: The share of adults who rent their homes is 37 percent, according to census figures.
Online sales make up a fifth of all retail, a figure the agency publishes yearly.
The number of bike commuters is about 9 percent, a figure that includes students.
Household savings are held mostly in bank accounts, the report found.
Enrollment in language courses is open to all students, the website says.
The proportion of women in parliament is listed in a table on page 12.
Smoking rates among teenagers are measured with an anonymous survey.
Applications to the program are reviewed by a panel of three teachers.

notes: Top examples peak on the comma/verb following trend statistics ('rose to 66 percent in 2010,', 'has risen to nearly 60 percent,'). The + pole is 'more and more / immer / ever'. Near misses state static figures.
